gloss: print medium; paper format; hard copy

definitions.gloss: print medium; paper format; hard copy
definitions.explanation: Information or content published in printed form on paper, as opposed to digital or electronic formats. Commonly used in discussions contrasting traditional and digital media.

examples.japanese: {紙媒体|かみばいたい}の{新聞|しんぶん}を{読|よ}んでいる。
examples.english: I read the newspaper in print.

examples.japanese: この{資料|しりょう}は{紙媒体|かみばいたい}でもらえますか。
examples.english: Can I get this material in print format?

examples.japanese: {紙媒体|かみばいたい}の{売|う}り{上|あ}げは{年々|ねんねん}{減少|げんしょう}しているが、{電子書籍|でんししょせき}は{伸|の}びている。
examples.english: Sales of print media are declining year by year, but e-books are growing.

notes:
A compound of {紙|かみ} (paper) + {媒体|ばいたい} (medium). Frequently used in business, publishing, and media contexts to distinguish physical printed materials from their digital counterparts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {紙媒体|かみばいたい}の{本|ほん}: a physical book
- {紙媒体|かみばいたい}で{配布|はいふ}する: to distribute in print form
- {紙媒体|かみばいたい}から{電子化|でんしか}: digitization from paper

CONTRASTED WITH:
- {電子媒体|でんしばいたい}: electronic/digital medium
- {電子書籍|でんししょせき}: e-book
- {デジタル版|でじたるばん}: digital edition
- {ウェブ版|うぇぶばん}: web edition

USAGE:
Often used in the pattern {紙媒体|かみばいたい}で (in print format) as an adverbial phrase. In business meetings, you may hear people ask {紙媒体|かみばいたい}でいただけますか (could I have a hard copy?).
